title: Northwind — Sales Overview
description: Revenue, orders and product performance from the star schema. Reads the current-row views, never the raw tables: ReplacingMergeTree leaves unmerged duplicates behind and SCD type 2 keeps closed rows, both of which would inflate every figure here.

panels.title: Total revenue
panels.description: Sum of line_total, which is materialised at insert as unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount).

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(sum(line_total), 0) AS revenue FROM v_FactOrders_Current

panels.title: Orders
panels.description: Distinct order ids. The fact grain is (order, product), so counting rows would count order lines instead.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(order_id) AS orders FROM v_FactOrders_Current

panels.title: Average order value
panels.description: Revenue per order, computed by aggregating lines to orders first. Averaging line_total directly would give the average line, not the average order.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(order_total), 2) AS aov FROM (SELECT order_id, sum(line_total) AS order_total FROM v_FactOrders_Current GROUP BY order_id)

panels.title: Total freight
panels.description: Freight belongs to the order but repeats on every line, so it is deduplicated to one value per order before summing. Summing it directly would multiply it by the number of lines per order.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(sum(freight), 0) AS total_freight FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, freight FROM v_FactOrders_Current)

panels.title: Monthly revenue
panels.description: Revenue by order month. Joined to DimDate rather than deriving the month from order_date, so the calendar attributes stay defined in one place.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.full_date) AS time, round(sum(f.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM v_FactOrders_Current AS f INNER JOIN DimDate AS d ON d.date_key = f.order_date_key GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Revenue by category
panels.description: Category lives on DimProducts rather than in a dimension of its own — the snowflake was flattened during staging.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.category_name AS category, round(sum(f.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM v_FactOrders_Current AS f INNER JOIN v_DimProducts_Current AS p ON p.product_key = f.product_key GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT p.product_name AS product, round(sum(f.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM v_FactOrders_Current AS f INNER JOIN v_DimProducts_Current AS p ON p.product_key = f.product_key GROUP BY product ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.company_name AS customer, g.country AS country, uniqExact(f.order_id) AS orders, round(sum(f.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM v_FactOrders_Current AS f INNER JOIN v_DimCustomer_Current AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key LEFT JOIN DimGeography AS g ON g.geography_key = c.geography_key GROUP BY customer, country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
